# Coffee With Bro

> Real-time, 100% offline American Sign Language (ASL) to written text recognition system built with React, Spring Boot, and DeepLearning4j.

Coffee With Bro is an academic software engineering project developed for UCS503 Software Engineering at Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology (Odd Semester 2026–27). It enables live webcam-based hand sign classification across 36 static ASL classes (A–Z, 0–9) without cloud APIs, remote inference endpoints, or telemetry.

## System Architecture

The platform follows a modular, decoupled architecture:
- **`coffee_with_bro`**: Java 17 backend hosting a Spring Boot WebSocket service (`ws://localhost:8080/ws/echo`) and an onboard DeepLearning4j (DL4J) Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).
- **`milk_with_bro`**: Client web application built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite. Streams JPEG frame snapshots every ~350ms, receives predictions with confidence scores, and builds a transcript buffer.
- **`ice_with_bro`**: Python data engineering pipeline for dataset image normalization (128x128), MediaPipe 21-joint 3D landmark extraction, and baseline PyTorch neural network training.
- **`cream_with_bro`**: Software engineering documentation including IEEE 830 SRS specifications, UML activity and use-case diagrams, and LaTeX reports.
- **`sugar_with_bro`**: Standalone HTML/JS WebSocket diagnostic test bench for isolated backend validation.

## Core Pages & Resources

- [Live ASL Translator](https://coffeewithbro.local/): Main interface with camera viewfinder, alignment brackets, recognition meter, and speech synthesis transcript buffer.
- [About the System](https://coffeewithbro.local/about): Technical explanation of capture, WebSocket streaming, 128x128 CNN classification, and FAQ.
- [Team & Contact Details](https://coffeewithbro.local/team): Engineering contributors, university affiliation, and direct author bios.
- [Open Source Resources](https://coffeewithbro.local/resources): Attribution of software libraries, models, and open source licenses (Spring Boot, DL4J, ND4J, MediaPipe, React 19).
- [Terms of Use](https://coffeewithbro.local/legal): Academic assessment disclaimer and acceptable use terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://coffeewithbro.local/privacy): 100% on-device memory guarantee; no video disk persistence, no cookies, zero external telemetry.
- [XML Sitemap](https://coffeewithbro.local/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all canonical routes.

## Technical Specifications

- **Inference Mode**: Local JVM CNN (DeepLearning4j MultiLayerNetwork)
- **Input Resolution**: 128x128 pixels, 3 channels (RGB)
- **Classes**: 36 classes (A–Z, 0–9)
- **Sampling Frequency**: ~350 ms per frame snapshot
- **WebSocket Route**: `ws://localhost:8080/ws/echo`
- **Data Privacy**: Frames held exclusively in volatile memory for the duration of inference, then discarded immediately.
